meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Guidance and local audit tools for Python workflows that directly use GeoPandas GeoSeries, GeoDataFrame, spatial operations, or vector-data I/O.

copy.tagline: 审核并指导GeoPandas空间数据处理流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用GeoPandas处理地理空间数据并需要质量保障。
copy.tagline_en: Audit and guide GeoPandas spatial data workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with GeoPandas for geospatial data and need quality assurance.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会参考GeoPandas文档来回答地理矢量数据问题，提供读写文件、坐标参考系、几何与空间分析等代码示例。
howto.when: 当你处理地理矢量数据，涉及空间分析、几何操作、坐标变换等任务时触发。通常出现在读写地理文件或要求分析地图数据时。

say.text: 用 GeoPandas 读取这个 GeoJSON，按字段制作专题图。
say.note: 会给出读取和绘图的代码。

say.text: 把这两个地理数据做空间连接，统计每个区域内的点数。
say.note: 执行空间连接并输出聚合结果。

say.text: 将数据重投影到 EPSG:3857，再计算面积。
say.note: 处理坐标参考系并返回面积列。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use this skill to answer GeoPandas questions, providing code examples for file I/O, CRS handling, geometric and spatial analysis, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you work with geospatial vector data involving spatial analysis, geometric operations, coordinate transformations, etc. Typically when reading/writing geographic files or analyzing map data.

say_en.text: Use GeoPandas to read this GeoJSON and make a thematic map by field.
say_en.note: Provides code for reading and plotting.

say_en.text: Spatially join these two datasets and count points in each region.
say_en.note: Performs spatial join and returns aggregated result.

say_en.text: Reproject the data to EPSG:3857 and calculate area.
say_en.note: Handles CRS and returns area column.
